header.alt: ADB-PC-GN01 90kVA bidirectional DC/AC converter — front panel showing DC+/DC− and three-phase AC (L1, L2, L3, N) RADSOK high-current connectors, 24V control power input, and CAN link ports, in a sealed liquid-cooled enclosure

hardwareDescription: The Silicon Carbide (SiC) topology delivers 98.5% peak efficiency over a broad operating range and yields a more compact package through higher power density. The system is fully sealed and liquid cooled, ready to deploy in harsh environments, including off-highway applications.

The GN01 inverter operates on-grid, off-grid, or as part of a smart microgrid. Its active neutral supports load imbalances up to 100% per phase, ensuring stable performance even under highly uneven load distributions. The unit is fully user-configurable for any standard voltage up to 480 VAC and frequencies up to 400 Hz, making it compatible to a wide range of power grids across industries globally. It functions to stabilize voltage and frequency, balancing demand peaks, and delivering cleaner, more reliable power to the grid.

AC Droop control lets the user set target voltage and frequency, then overlay bidirectional active and reactive power control — useful for storage regulation, seamless AC synchronization, AC hot swaps, and generator hybridization. Droop parameters are exposed for real-time tuning by integrators, rather than locked behind firmware. Each unit takes CAN control locally, but coordination across units happen on the AC waveform itself. Voltage and frequency carry the signal, so any number of units can run in parallel on a shared AC grid without an additional communications layer between them.

When connected to a grid, GN01 can idle alongside the mains while the battery handles other duties, such as peak shaving, frequency regulation, or standing by. If an upstream breaker opens, including during islanding events, the inverter assumes the load with no transfer interruption. This delivers reliable ride-through performance equivalent to a uninterruptible power supply (UPS) as a native function of the grid-forming control, without a dedicated UPS in the system.
characteristics: Power up to megawatt levels through paralleling
Full bidirectional operation for charging through the same converters
Support for all common grid standards up to 480 V, single-, split- and three-phase inverters, 50 - 400 Hz
applications: Portable battery gensets (90 kW up to megawatt levels)
Integration with other power sources such as solar and diesel generation
Portable DC fast charging, by integrating [ADM-PC-DC01](https://advantics.fr/products/ADB-PC-DC01/)
